transcript.text: I was thinking about that Chengdu trip back in 2025—funny how we basically just wandered around and played everything by ear.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: We ended up checking what shows were around in town, and somehow the one everyone kept talking about was this thing called “Teahouse.”

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My friend went all-out and grabbed VIP seats, and it was just two tickets—honestly way nicer than I expected.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The tickets were under Lucas Martinez, and the contact number they used was 13892862812—he was the one organizing it, not me.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Same trip, we were also chatting about restaurants in Chengdu, and someone suggested Lao Ma Tou Hotpot—classic choice.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: They actually booked it for 2025-03-04 at 20:00, for a party of 5—so it was all set before I even showed up.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Oh, and the reservation contact was Zhao Min with 13811223344. Later on, when I got back to Chongqing, I remember browsing home services stuff there too—and I still owed Li Na, so I transferred 638.42 to her and called it done.
